author: Mark Atwood
text: Workspace-wide calibration: jmap-mail-types is the canonical template per workspace AGENTS.md, and its 8 Property enums in backend.rs ALSO lack #[non_exhaustive] — chat-types' shape matches the canonical defect. The other extension-types siblings (calendars-types, contacts-types, tasks-types) DO have #[non_exhaustive] on their Property enums. So the workspace-wide fix is: add #[non_exhaustive] in jmap-mail-types first (canonical), then propagate to jmap-chat-types. Filing this here keeps the chat-types finding clean; a parallel mail-types finding belongs under /review-workspace-api or a separate per-crate review. Not blocking — both crates' Property enums shipped pre-existing (the JMAP-ly0n diff did not introduce the defect), so no regression to roll back.
